lines.text: The high priest asks Stephen if the charges are true, and Stephen says God appeared to Abraham in Mesopotamia.
Abraham settles in Haran, and God promises him the land and says his descendants will be enslaved four hundred years.
Jacob's sons sell Joseph into Egypt out of jealousy, and Pharaoh makes him commander of his army before famine strikes.

wrong_details.true: ruler over Egypt and all his household

lines.text: A new king oppresses Israel, Pharaoh's daughter raises Moses, and after he kills an Egyptian he flees to Midian.
An angel appears to Moses in a burning bush near Mount Sinai, and later the people make a calf and God threatens exile beyond Damascus.
